growthclaw_list_tasks.description: List tasks with optional status filter (e.g. needs-approval, approved, done)

growthclaw_approve_tasks.description: Approve one task by id, or all eligible tasks when taskId is omitted (POST to approve-bulk)

taskId.description: Task id; omit to approve all

growthclaw_run_workflow.description: Run a workflow. workflowId: intake-and-plan, execute-task, strategy-evolution, or dispatcher. taskArg required for execute-task (task id), optional for intake-and-plan (e.g. website URL)

growthclaw_approve_strategy.description: Approve a strategy approval batch by strategyVersionId

growthclaw_dispatch_next.description: Run the dispatcher: pick the next eligible approved task and run execute-task for it
